events.name: RUN_TOGGLED
events.description: The evolution was started or paused — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.

events.name: GRID_STEPPED
events.description: A single-step advanced the world by one generation, with the new active-cell census.
events.synonyms: cellular automaton, game of life, grid world, emergence, local rules, spread, diffusion

events.name: CELL_TOGGLED
events.description: The learner toggled a cell by tapping it, with the new active-cell census.

events.name: GRID_RESET
events.description: The learner restored the world to its configured seeds.

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: RUN
events.description: Learner started the evolution; the grid advances one generation per tick until Pause.

events.name: PAUSE
events.description: Learner froze the evolution; tapping and single-stepping still work.

events.name: STEP
events.description: Learner advanced exactly one generation while paused — the microscope view of the rule.

events.name: TAP_CELL
events.description: Learner tapped a cell on the canvas — the canvas callback wraps its click info as payload { id, type, index }, where index is the flat cell index; the cell toggles between empty and active, seeding or editing the world.

events.name: RESET
events.description: Learner restored the configured seed pattern and zeroed the generation counter.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Auto Run
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether the evolution starts running immediately on load.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Decay
overridableConfigKeys.description: Diffusion rule only: fraction of a cell's value retained each generation.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Diffuse Rate
overridableConfigKeys.description: Diffusion rule only: how strongly a cell moves toward its neighbourhood average each generation.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Match Mode
overridableConfigKeys.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Rule
overridableConfigKeys.description: The local update rule: life (Conway birth-3 survive-2-3), spread (an active 4-neighbour activates a cell), or diffusion (cells relax toward the neighbourhood average with decay).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: game of life, contagion, wavefront, heat diffusion, cellular automaton rule

overridableConfigKeys.label: Seeds
overridableConfigKeys.description: Flat cell indexes (row·cols + col) active at the start — the default plants a glider and a blinker. Realizations declare their own starting pattern here.

overridableConfigKeys.default: Tap cells to seed the world, then Run — or Step one generation at a time to see the rule at work.
overridableConfigKeys.label: Task Text
overridableConfigKeys.description: One-sentence statement of what to explore.
